flagged_sentences: Community paramedicine programs, reviewed in a 2024 Springer Nature study, have reduced emergency-department transports by fourteen to seventy-eight percent across eleven studies, cutting attendance costs by hundreds of dollars per case in higher-quality evaluations.

claims.claim: Keeping one ambulance unit staffed and ready costs about one hundred dollars per hour or two thousand four hundred dollars per day according to the Massachusetts Ambulance Association.
claims.episode_span: The Massachusetts Ambulance Association states that keeping one unit staffed and ready costs about one hundred dollars per hour, or two thousand four hundred dollars per day, whether the crew answers eight calls or two.
claims.source_title: The Price of Being Ready: The Economics of Running an Ambulance Service
claims.supporting_quote: Say it costs $100 an hour to keep one ambulance staffed and ready. That’s $2,400 a day.

claims.claim: Personnel costs account for roughly seventy percent of ambulance service expenses, and one 24/7 staffed ambulance costs about eight hundred fifty thousand dollars per year, per LegalClarity.
claims.episode_span: Personnel account for roughly seventy percent of total expenses, according to LegalClarity. A single 24/7 ambulance therefore runs about eight hundred fifty thousand dollars a year before any transport occurs.
claims.supporting_quote: A single ambulance staffed 24 hours a day, seven days a week, costs roughly $850,000 per year to operate.

claims.claim: Community paramedicine programs reduced emergency-department transports by fourteen to seventy-eight percent and cut costs by AU$338–1,227 per attendance according to a 2024 Springer Nature systematic review.
claims.episode_span: Community paramedicine programs, reviewed in a 2024 Springer Nature study, have reduced emergency-department transports by fourteen to seventy-eight percent across eleven studies, cutting attendance costs by hundreds of dollars per case in higher-quality evaluations.
claims.source_title: The Economic Impact of Community Paramedics Within Emergency Medical Services: A Systematic Review
claims.supporting_quote: community paramedicine reduces ED transports by 14–78% (50–54% in higher-quality studies) and costs by AU$338–1,227 per attendance
